Hi Karthik + Laura —

Following up on Evan Park (SWE, backend)—he's excited about Redwood after the onsite call with Sam Ortiz. He can do a hybrid-style virtual loop next Wednesday (Dec 7) and asked if we could keep the day compact (five 45-min slots, one stretch).

Attached: EvanPark_Resume.pdf and a rough slot rotation (panel-rotation-rough.xlsx). Proposed sequence below — aiming to minimize context switching for domain and systems reviewers:

- 09:00 PT: Hiring manager kickoff (Sam Ortiz) — 30m
- 09:40 PT: Systems design panel — 45m
- 11:00 PT: Backend deep-dive (algorithmic/state) — 45m
- 13:00 PT: Lunch break / buffer — 45m
- 14:00 PT: Product/PO pairing — 45m
- 15:00 PT: Culture & leadership — 30m

Two asks: can Redwood provide a quiet-window contact for the candidate (single point of contact) and do we have an interviewer brief ready? I included a suggested interviewer-brief.pdf in Drive (link below).

Candidate contact: Evan Park <evan.park@example.com>. He prefers morning start but flexible within PT working hours.

Thanks — Giulia
Recruiter | TalentBridge

Giulia —

Thanks for the note and the attachments. The sequence looks good overall; a couple of tweaks from my side:

1) Swap the Backend deep-dive and Systems design slots — I want the systems panel before the algorithmic session so reviewers have the high-level context.
2) Make the hiring manager kickoff 20–30m max (we've found 30m eats into buffer).
3) Add a 15-minute 'context handoff' at the top of the systems panel for the scribe to summarize interviews 1–2.

Laura — are you ok to lead interviewer brief distribution? Also pushing to keep the lunch buffer at 45m; candidate prefers a real break rather than back-to-back.

I'll hold off on calendar invites until we confirm interviewer availability. If anyone can't make the proposed sequence, flag them and suggest alternates.

Karthik Iyer
Director, Platform Engineering
